phrase_pass_moved.result: all 21 moved grids now match rekordbox exactly
phrase_pass_moved.invariant: BPM, beat count, spacing, per-beat tempo and PQT2 µs remainders still match on all 21

unmoved_copies_identical: of the 5 click_128_offset1234 copies rekordbox did not move (mp3 x3, m4a aac, wav 96k), we leave the 4 MP3/AAC copies alone and match exactly

phrase_pass_miss.ours: moved +936 ms onto the first kick (first beat 1232 ms)
phrase_pass_miss.rekordbox: not moved (first beat 296 ms), although its PSSI shows the pass ran
phrase_pass_miss.hypothesis: BeatposCorrection2016's digital-silence test before the onset: our 96->48 kHz SRC output is exactly zero up to the click; rekordbox's re-read stream probably is not (resampler priming after the rewind, or a one-sample offset). analysis-phrase.md § 6, § 10

oracle_b: not applicable: high precision on (BALib v2 + madmom), see spec § 9
